proposals.proposed_change: Add User Story 10 (SSD Capacity Eviction) + FR-029..FR-033 covering trigger condition, LRU eviction, entry filtering, low-watermark stop, shutdown, and config fields
proposals.rationale: Without SSD eviction, drives fill up and write-throughs fail silently, causing permanent data loss on memory-tier eviction

proposals.spec_text: Count-based TSC eviction (from v0) is NOT used in v1
proposals.actual_behavior: DispatcherConfig still includes max_cache_entries and eviction_threshold fields, unused by v1 logic
proposals.proposed_change: Add deprecation doc comments to the fields and a clarification note in the spec
proposals.rationale: Removing fields is breaking; deprecation with documentation is minimal-risk
